proves.claim: a board write held over 1,000 ms records a named WRITE_HOLD_OVER_1S violation with move, seat, pid and held ms on its board-writes.jsonl row and in a counter row the status reader can read by key.

store.io-board-write-lock.hold-over-one-.why: A board write over a second must leave keyed telemetry that names the move and writer, while a shorter write stays unmarked.

store.io-board-write-lock.hold-under-one.why: The threshold must not mark a write that stays below one second.
